mapper.select: SELECT command_id, document_id, recipient_id, operation, accepted_revision, accepted_at, fingerprint FROM knowledge_sharing_command WHERE tenant_id=#{caller.tenantId} AND owner_id=#{caller.userId} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT recipient_id AS user_id FROM knowledge_document_share WHERE tenant_id=#{caller.tenantId} AND owner_id=#{caller.userId} AND document_id=#{id} AND active=TRUE ORDER BY recipient_id LIMIT 101
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET sharing_revision=sharing_revision+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{caller.tenantId} AND owner_id=#{caller.userId} AND document_id=#{id} AND sharing_revision=#{revision}
mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_document_share share WHERE share.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND share.document_id=d.document_id AND share.owner_id=d.owner_id AND share.recipient_id=#{caller.userId} AND share.active=TRUE)

FROM knowledge_document d JOIN knowledge_document_revision r ON r.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND r.owner_id=d.owner_id AND r.document_id=d.document_id AND r.content_revision=d.published_version JOIN knowledge_ingestion j ON j.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND j.owner_id=d.owner_id AND j.document_id=d.document_id AND j.job_id=d.published_job_id AND j.index_generation=d.published_generation AND j.document_version=d.published_version WHERE d.tenant_id=#{caller.tenantId} AND d.lifecycle='ACTIVE' AND d.lifecycle_ready=TRUE AND j.status='READY' AND j.content_hash=r.content_hash AND
mapper.select: SELECT d.document_id,r.display_name,d.published_version, CASE WHEN d.owner_id=#{caller.userId} THEN d.status ELSE 'READY' END AS status FROM knowledge_document d JOIN knowledge_document_revision r ON r.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND r.owner_id=d.owner_id AND r.document_id=d.document_id AND r.content_revision=CASE WHEN d.owner_id=#{caller.userId} THEN d.version ELSE d.published_version END WHERE d.tenant_id=#{caller.tenantId} AND d.lifecycle='ACTIVE' AND d.lifecycle_ready=TRUE AND (d.owner_id=#{caller.userId} OR ( AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_ingestion j WHERE j.job_id=d.published_job_id AND j.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND j.owner_id=d.owner_id AND j.document_id=d.document_id AND j.document_version=d.published_version AND j.index_generation=d.published_generation AND j.status='READY' AND j.content_hash=r.content_hash))) AND d.document_id=#{id} AND d.document_id > #{after} ORDER BY d.document_id LIMIT #{limit}
